title: Strong flagship franchise
evidence: Ultomiris + Voydeya accounts for $4,016m of reported 9M 2026 Rare Disease revenue.
implication: Protect leadership while monitoring concentration risk.

title: Growing diversified anchors
evidence: Strensiq grew 37% CER and Koselugo 15% CER in 9M 2026.
implication: Maintain access and scientific education across franchises.

title: Portfolio concentration
evidence: Ultomiris including Voydeya represents about 53% of Rare Disease revenue.
implication: Diversify the growth mix and track concentration each quarter.

title: Established-brand erosion
implication: Plan lifecycle transition and realistic legacy-brand forecasts.

title: Pipeline and label expansion
evidence: Rare Disease pipeline includes Phase III efzimfotase alfa, eneboparatide and additional projects.
implication: Use milestone tracking to evaluate development opportunities.

title: Market access expansion
evidence: The 2026 results cite geographic launches and increasing demand for Ultomiris and Strensiq.
implication: Track country-level reimbursement and launch progress.

title: Eculizumab biosimilars
evidence: FDA lists Bkemv and Epysqli as biosimilars referencing Soliris.
implication: Monitor competitive entrants and erosion by geography.

title: Regulatory and development uncertainty
evidence: Rare-disease pipeline assets face clinical, approval and reimbursement uncertainty.
implication: Build scenario analysis; do not treat pipeline assets as approved sales.
